jobs.prompt:
Tenth Opus review of auto-approve v1 (file tools on docs/state only): FAIL (1 high conditional, several medium). Fix all, a test each in tests/auto-approve.test.mjs, keep all other tests passing.
1 HIGH policy rows are stored as ordinary approved rows with files; the Bash branch, covers() and activeApprovals do not leave them out, so a shell write to a window file (redirect, tee, sed -i, cp, mv, ln, an interpreter with redirected output) may be allowed through covers(files) with no owner involved. Leave rows marked as policy rows (policyId or autoApproved) out of EVERY Bash and shell-write covers() decision and out of every other consumer except the Write, Edit and NotebookEdit window check; deny any Bash allow whose approval is a policy row. Add a test that a Bash command writing a window file with a live policy window is denied exactly as without a window.
2 MEDIUM protect both ~/.config and the XDG_CONFIG_HOME locations (when set) for project-swarm, git and fish, always, regardless of which one the policy code reads.
3 MEDIUM protected absolute paths compared as text: resolve the deepest existing ancestor (realpath) before comparing so a symlink into a protected folder is caught; extend the protected list with ~/.claude.json, the whole ~/.claude folder, ~/Library/LaunchAgents, ~/.npmrc, ~/.config/gh, ~/.gnupg, ~/.local/bin, ~/bin and /usr/local/bin and /opt/homebrew/bin.
4 MEDIUM the check-to-write race: add a post-write verification (the PostToolUse side of the guard if the hook supports it, otherwise a check the guard runs at the next tool call and on `swarm handbuild stats`): inode, nlink equal to 1, not a symlink, the file still inside docs/state; on violation write an alert line to the handbuild log, turn the auto-off kill switch on and surface it in swarm brief. Also refuse window files whose parent folder is a symlink or is group or world writable.
5 MEDIUM out-of-scope hunks remain: revert the SAFE_SWARM pattern additions in tools/self-approval.mjs to main exactly, and revert the swarm merge finishAllow changes in tools/handbuild.mjs (tryConsumeChatMerge, the standing tag, the unused swarmMergeAllow) to main's exact code. After this the diff of tools/handbuild.mjs, tools/self-approval.mjs and tools/shell-writes.mjs against main must contain no git, merge, Bash or safe-pattern hunks.
6 LOW run the ASCII test on the RAW path before folding, in isPolicyWindowFileEntry, docsStateComponentsAscii and the lstat check of new files (canonical spelling must equal the raw spelling).
7 LOW the owner-terminal stats bump in decideRequest must not write when the unreadable flag is set; call bumpHandbuildStats or skip.
8 LOW enforce the docs/state readers list: the policy refuses window files whose basename is in an explicit deny list built from the readers named in docs/auto-approve.md (list them as constants), and drop .ndjson from the allowed extensions (md, txt, csv only).
